component.name: FastCheckup
component.summary: Inspect your Linux system and act on each finding

description.p: FastCheckup shows what is slow, large, unused or exposed on your computer and lets you act on each item one at a time. Nothing changes until you confirm it, most changes can be undone, and every change is logged in History.

ul.li: Speed: startup entries, services and where boot time goes
Space: caches, build folders, old installers and leftovers, sorted by how safe they are to remove
Safety: disk health, open ports, things that start by themselves, browser add-ons and weak spots in your network
Apps: installed Debian, Flatpak and AppImage apps with their size and last data activity
System: what this computer is, and whether graphics acceleration works

screenshot.caption: Overview: one card per area and what is using memory right now
Space: clean-ups sorted by how safe they are to remove
Services: what each one is and what disabling it does
Security: devices on your local network and their open ports
Apps: installed programs with size and last data activity
